description: The full 8 February Journal article reports a fourth HORECA gathering on Saturday (date derived as 6 February) in Luxembourg City, but gives no attendance, exact venue, specific government-directed request, physical end or event-specific response. The single body read therefore does not establish the 50-person and domestic-state-demand criteria.
required_followup: Seek an accessible contemporaneous report or organizer/official record establishing actual attendance and the demand. Preserve the inferred date and unknown end until directly supported.

description: The exact Le Quotidien S002 body remains unread after four fresh prerequisite chains ended before a request: R001 deferred on unstable inputs; R005 failed its immediate input-hash check; R006 stopped after the manual-review command error; R007 stopped after the preflight syntax error, with a later diagnostic showing changed input. description: January’s weekly HORECA gatherings (Jan 16, 23 and 30) are recorded as separate actions. The 6 February Journal gathering is described as a fourth meeting; the 11 February Place d’Armes event is a separate reported action. No uninterrupted event across dates or into March is established. description: Searches used English, French, German and Luxembourgish terms, including date windows and local sectors, but open-web search is not LexisNexis or systematic local newspaper coverage. No official baseline/manual availability or complete source-origin map was established. The 18 exact-URL cards include one full written-body read and 17 search-only leads; counts do not establish source independence, completeness or exhaustiveness.
required_followup: Coordinator should compare candidates and source scope with the official baseline when available. Any wider completeness or source-independence claim requires systematic archive/origin review.
